tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: A show cause notice has been received under Gujarat Value Added Tax Act, 2003 for the Financial Year 2009-10 to 2014-15 demanding the Value Added Tax liability on medicine supplied to the patient admitted to hospital. Such notice has been challenged in to the Hon’ble High Court of Gujarat. The first appeal had been filed before the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax (Appeal) – 1, Ahmedabad but appeal order was received in the favour of Value Added Tax Department. Hence Second Appeal had been field before the Gujarat Value Added Tax Tribunal for which the proceeding is still going on.
tax_litigation.status: High court order received was not in our favour. Pitition has been filed in suprem court.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Before the demerger of Shalby Surat Hospital Pvt. Ltd. (SSHPL) with Company, SSHPL was issued an unquoted share with premium to investor. Such premium has been calculated based on the book value as per the valuation report. The Assessing Officer has disallowed such premium and added to income under section 68 vide assessment order under section 143(3) dated 28.12.2017. An appeal has been filed against such Assessment Order before Commissioner of Income tax (Appeal)-8, Ahmedabad for which the proceeding is still going on.
tax_litigation.status: Appeal at ITAT has been filed on 06.12.2023 against order passed by CIT(A) and appeal proceedings is in process.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Levy of penalty and demand of Input Tax Credit wrongly availed amounting to Rs.6,20,80,588/‐ (Rupees Six Crores Twenty Lakhs Eighty Thousand Five Hundred and Eighty Eight only) for the period from 2017‐18 (from July‐2017) to 2022‐23 under the provisions of Section 74 of the CGST/CGGST Act, 2017, plus applicable interest, plus equivalent amount of Penalty of Rs. 6,20,80,588/‐ (Rupees Six Crores Twenty Lakhs Eighty Thousand Five Hundred and Eighty Eight only).
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Joint Commissioner - CGST & Central Excise - Jabalpur (Madhya Pradesh)
tax_litigation.status: As per the direction given by Hon'ble High Court of Madhya Pradesh in the matter of writ petition filed, hence, the appeal has been filed on May 14, 2025 with Commissiner (Appeals) and appeal proceedings is in process. As on date, there is no implication on the financials. We anticipate that we will get verdict in our favour on the basis of facts of the matter involved, analysis of the provisions of the law, available judicial precedents & basis our consultation with our legal advisor.

guidance.statement: Shalby International to achieve PBT positive

operating_notes.text: Company adopted lower tax regime under Section 115BAA, resulting in a deferred tax recomputation impact of ₹340.16 million and write-off of MAT credit entitlement of ₹42.36 million in Q4FY26.
Company shifted to the lower tax regime under Section 115BAA at 25% tax rate.
Shalby International (Gurgaon) achieved EBITDA break-even for the first time
Hospital occupancy excluding Shalby International at 51%, with 701 occupied beds
Payer mix: 30% self-pay, 38% insurance, 32% government business
Jabalpur hospital registration suspended pending fire and electrical safety audits following a minor fire incident.

timeline.summary: Shalby announced the strike-off of its non-operational step-down subsidiary Ningen Lifecare Pvt. Ltd. effective May 12, 2026.

Shalby Limited scheduled an earnings conference call on May 29, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST to discuss Q4 FY 2026 earnings, led by Dr. Vikram Shah, Mr. Shanay Shah, Dr. Nishita Shukla, Mr. Deepak Anand, Mr. Amit Kumar, Mr. Babu Thomas, and Mr. Jigar Todi.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹287.44 Cr (+8.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹18.32 Cr (against a loss of ₹11.02 Cr a year earlier).
Shalby published its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26 on May 27, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹295.54 Cr and PAT of ₹18.5 Cr.
Shalby Limited shared the Q4 FY 2026 earnings conference call audio recording on May 29, 2026, via the provided link.
Shalby Limited reported Q4 FY26 earnings on May 29, 2026, highlighting positive EBITDA in its MedTech division and a lower tax regime benefit.
Dr. Vikram Shah, a promoter of Shalby Limited, declared no encumbrances on company shares held by promoters or promoter group during FY2025-26, as of March 31, 2026.

Shalby Limited held Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 13, 2026, discussing unaudited results with consolidated revenue up 11.6% YoY to ₹338.6 Cr, hospital EBITDA margin at 14.5%, and MedTech revenue up 53% YoY to ₹47 Cr.
On October 14, 2026, Shalby Limited informed the exchange that the registration of its Jabalpur hospital was suspended by the CMHO pending safety reports.
Shalby Limited scheduled an earnings conference call on Wednesday, 4 November 2026 at 4:00 PM IST to discuss Q2 FY 2027 earnings.
